summary: Silvercorp Metals filed a 6-K attaching a September 17, 2026 news release announcing renewal of its normal course issuer bid (the Canadian equivalent of a US buyback program). The company may repurchase up to 8,848,585 common shares, about 4% of the 221,214,642 shares outstanding as of September 8, 2026, from September 21, 2026 until September 20, 2027, at prevailing market prices on the TSX, NYSE American and alternative systems, with cancellation of repurchased shares. No advisor or board recommendation named; no shares were bought under the prior 2025 NCIB. Watch actual purchase pace and any officer or 10% holder selling into the bid.
